Dual mode: save ("write a handoff", "save progress") and restore ("continue from last time", "where did we leave off"). Multiple handoffs on the same topic are chained into one thread.
Trigger: /grace-handoff, "write a handoff", "save progress", "continue from last time", "where did we leave off"
